title: Odd Even Linked List
statement_md:
Given an array of integers `values` representing a singly linked list, group all nodes with odd indices together followed by the nodes with even indices (1-indexed: 1st, 3rd, 5th... then 2nd, 4th, 6th...). Return the reordered array.

**Function:** `oddEvenList(values)`

**Input:** one JSON value per parameter, in the order above. **Output:** the returned value as JSON.
hints: Work out how the pointers (or positions) of the nodes must change.
Use two pointers, or first collect the values into a list and reason about indexes.
Data structure: two pointers (slow and fast), or a list of values to rebuild the order.
